scene.prompt: Niani, royal town of the Mali empire on the Sankarani river: round mud houses with conical thatch, a walled royal compound, millet fields and baobabs on dry savanna

Timbuktu at the edge of the Sahara: flat-roofed mud-brick houses, the Djinguereber and Sankore mosques with wooden beams jutting from the walls, camel caravans and sand dunes, the Niger port of Kabara nearby
Gao, Songhai capital on the river Niger: mud-brick compounds, the pyramidal tomb of Askia Muhammad, long dugout canoes and fishermen on the wide river, dry savanna beyond
Djenne in the inland Niger delta: the great mud-brick mosque with palm-wood spikes, a market square full of traders, the town on an island surrounded by flooded rice fields and canoes
